source: Working tree on top of the source base

runtime.scope: Isolated PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7.2, shared journal directory, Chromium and n8n 1.32.0

criteria: Browser history exposes delivery UUID, outcomes, attempt times and retry deadlines. A 403 to replay to 204 uses the same UUID.
Legacy callback keeps its body. n8n 1.32.0 registers the canonical subscription and completes one workflow after signed delivery.
PostgreSQL RLS proves atomic result/outbox, bounded retries and replay, lease fencing, queue limits and TTL. A test receiver performs one effect across two requests with the same UUID.
Byte-bounded read and upload, fixed concurrency and bounded ownership lookup.
Tenant-specific, daily and shared quota under a shared filesystem lock, including legacy and retired device journals.
Independent offline expiry, copy and restore, concurrent process writes, fixed label counts and forecast rule tested with promtool.
